title: Shane Steichen: Jonathan Taylor's on our football team, hasn't asked for a trade

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Shane Steichen: Jonathan Taylor's on our football team, hasn't asked for a trade
sources.description: Colts running back Jonathan Taylor's future in Indianapolis is the subject of much scrutiny right now, but head coach Shane Steichen said on Wednesday that Taylor isn't looking for an immediate exit.
